title: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Ahead of January Deadline
snippet: The rule sets reserve, redemption and risk standards for issuers, but the OCC has yet to say when it will begin accepting applications.

title: First out the gate: OCC debuts final rule implementing Trump-signed GENIUS Act
snippet: OCC published its final GENIUS Act stablecoin rule, effective Jan. 18, dropping a proposed presumption on third-party rewards arrangements.
